QuestInfo.name: Rushing to Rien
QuestInfo.1: Suspicious people visited #bRien#k. She could be in danger if it was the Black Wings.  #p1002104# said #p1404002# was rushing to the island, but you may get there faster!
QuestInfo.2: Stopping the Black Wings with #p1404002#'s help was a cinch. You also met up with #p1404001# while you were there.

1.0: Who are you? You don't look like a Black Wing. Wait, are you that Phantom character Mr. Tru told me about? \r\n#L0##bOne and the same. I was told Rien was in danger.#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, yeah it was, but Aran already saved everybody. I fled here for safety, but everything worked out fine. Still, thanks.\r\n#L0##bThink nothing of it. A quick trip to the cold lands is always good for my mood. Is the Seal Stone okay?#l\n#k
1.2: It didn't get stolen, if that's what you're asking. I'm not dumb to carry it around with me. It's locked up tight as can be in the Rien Library. But...

yes.0: I wanted to ask you something. Could I? Did that tiny battle wear you out?

npc.0: You haven't gone over to Rien yet? I thought you were a hero!
